claims: Viktor Gyokeres scored a hat-trick in Sweden's match against Ukraine.
Sweden advanced to the Path B final by beating Ukraine in March 2026.
Sweden vs. Poland is the Path B final of the 2026 World Cup qualification playoffs.
The Sweden vs. Poland Path B final is scheduled for March 31, 2026.
The Sweden vs. Poland Path B final will be held at Friends Arena in Stockholm.
Sweden will host Poland in the Path B final.
The winner of the Path B final qualifies for the 2026 World Cup.
Poland defeated Sweden 2-0 in the 2022 World Cup qualifiers.
Poland secured their place in the 2022 World Cup by defeating Sweden 2-0.
Sweden defeated Poland 3-2 in the Euro 2020 group stage.
